heroHeadline: Fifth Drone Breach in Two Weeks as Russian Strike Also Damages Border Crossing Metres From Moldova
heroSubtitle: Moldova's airspace has now been breached five times since August 9: a Shahed-type drone crossed into Gagauzia near Etulia and back in six minutes on the night of August 19-20, and a Shahed-138 crossed into the Ștefan Vodă district near Caplani on August 22. In between, Russian drones on August 21 damaged the Tabachi-Mirne checkpoint on the Ukrainian side of the border, roughly 300 metres from Moldovan territory, suspending traffic through the crossing. No debris or casualties were reported on Moldovan soil in any of the incidents, but the pace of incursions continues to escalate against the backdrop of Moscow's May 15 passportisation decree and Deputy Foreign Minister Galuzin's August 10 warning that any armed provocation against Transnistria would be treated as an attack on Russia.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
